page.layout: One page of text, single column, with no marginal notes. Running head at top, page number at top left. Heading "QVÆST. 19." and heading "RESPONSIO." set centred within the text. Large initials at the start of two paragraphs.

main_text.p: Tu autem illud facis Verro. Ergo tu ipse in Deum, & Christum Dominum contumeliosus, & eius criminis reus es, cuius impudenter nos insimulas, immò etiam accusas.
main_text.head: QVÆST. 19.
main_text.p: Qui album nigrum, & nigrum albū interpretatur:y nequaquam fideliter explicant, & interpretantur Scripturam. Zuingliani illud faciunt.

Ergo Scripturam nequaquam fideliter interpretantur. Probatio assumptionis, quòd scilicet Zuingliani album nigrum, & contrà, interpretentur. Quia BAPTIZARE secundum ipsorum interpretationem, in Scriptura idem quòd docere, aut prædicare significat.

Ἐπιπαταστευὴ[?] huius probationis: Zuinglius in 1.cap. Marci, hoc ita ausus fuit scribere. Deinde innumerabilia exempla huius audaciæ, qua Scripturam sacram ad peruersum nostrum sensum torquea-mus, te dicis breuitatis causa omittere.
main_text.head: RESPONSIO.
main_text.p: Ad posterius hoc, priore loco respondeo. Quando satis prolixè ac splen-didè

page.notes: The Greek word after the first paragraph's "E" is uncertain and marked [?]. The "y" in "interpretatur:y" is as printed (abbreviation for -ý or similar). The large initial "Q" with "Vi" is read as Qui. Faint show-through from the reverse side is ignored.
